WITH patient_lab_data AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.ALB, l.TP, l.APPT, l.PT
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ALB IS NOT NULL AND TP IS NOT NULL THEN ALB - TP END) as avg_alb_tp,
    AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT END) as avg_appt_pt
  FROM patient_lab_data
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
  SELECT SEX,
    AVG(avg_alb_tp) as sex_avg_alb_tp,
    AVG(avg_appt_pt) as sex_avg_appt_pt
  FROM patient_averages
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_avg_appt_pt) as mean_appt_pt FROM sex_averages
),
filtered_sexes AS (
  SELECT sa.SEX, sa.sex_avg_alb_tp, sa.sex_avg_appt_pt, om.mean_appt_pt
  FROM sex_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE sa.sex_avg_appt_pt > om.mean_appt_pt
)
SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb_tp) as avg_alb_tp, AVG(sex_avg_appt_pt) as avg_appt_pt, AVG(sex_avg_appt_pt - mean_appt_pt) as excess_over_mean
FROM filtered_sexes
